global_examples.how_they_closed_it: Continuous improvement of the automated fault recovery process workflows is an example of a process where such monitoring and update is done in the network.

The root cause analysis (RCA) from the fault recovery process is provided for configuring the management and orchestration functions, and also the effect produced by ML in the network is evaluated and used to optimize the ML functionalities themselves.
